From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Subject: POc capacity & evaluation plan — Quantile Health (next steps)

Hi Sara / Matthew —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kicks off: 

1) Goal / success criteria (what you confirmed on the call):
   - Evaluate model quality + latency on clinical summarization flows and extraction of structured fields from discharge notes.
   - Target acceptance: p95 latency < 250ms for 512-token generates, and extraction precision > 92% on your sample golden set.

2) Scope & timeline:
   - 2-week technical POC (start target: 2026-02-22) + 2-week optional extension for scale testing.
   - Deliverables: shared eval harness, baseline run, optimization recommendations, and a final throughput/latency report.

3) Capacity ask (what you flagged as expected traffic):
   - Baseline: 4 concurrent inference lanes (estimate: 80 real-time requests/minute; avg payload ~350 tokens).
   - Redwood proposal: reserve 4 x A100-80GB equivalent GPUs for the trial window with autoscaling to burst up to 12 GPUs for peak replay runs.
   - Autoscaling policy: add nodes when queue depth > 6 requests for more than 60s; scale down after 5 minutes idle.

4) Roles / ownership:
   - Quantile: provide 500 labeled samples + 2 anonymized clinical note templates for eval. (Sara)
   - Redwood: bench baseline, configure KV/prefix caching, run quantized variant and report. (Ben / Mina)
   - Internal ops contact for capacity: Dylan (SRE) will provision reserved pool and run the burst tests with your team.

5) Next steps (action items):
   - Sara: share the sample set and the security questionnaire by EOD Thu (2026-02-12).
   - Ben: send subscription/quote with reserved GPU pricing and the trial SLA draft by Tue (2026-02-11).
   - Mina + Dylan: sync on infra playbook and confirm exact instance types and IP allowlist needs by Fri (2026-02-13).

Attachments: I attached a short worksheet for expected request shape (Quantile_Requirements.xlsx) and a draft SLA (SLA_Draft_QH.pdf).

If that aligns I’ll book a quick 30-min kickoff for Mon 2026-02-22.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
